seed.brief: Exhaustively mine the full compressed-model supply chain for complaint lineages, unmet user requirements, and unresolved failures in quantization, pruning, sparse inference, conversion, and serving.

research_question: Under which model, task, state, hardware, backend, and kernel conditions do quantization or pruning fail to preserve quality, correctness, memory savings, or physical throughput?

corpus_contract.stopping_condition: Every source family and complaint-query family must reach two consecutive discovery waves with no new qualifying incident lineage.
target_sources: Hugging Face model uploads, discussions, pull requests, commits, and reuploads
quantizer, converter, packing, and kernel repositories
inference and serving runtime issue trackers
Reddit, X, Hacker News, Stack Exchange, and public technical forums
official implementation documentation and release-thread replies
primary studies, OpenReview discussions, and benchmark issue trackers
include: firsthand complaints with a named model, file, method, runtime, task, or configuration
maintainer-confirmed upload, conversion, backend, cache, or kernel failures
reports that expose an unmet user requirement even when the mechanism remains unknown
controlled results that bound or contradict community claims
negative performance results where the compressed path is compared with a dense baseline
quality failures tied to task, context length, language, state, hardware, topology, or concurrency
cross-source corroborations that strengthen an existing incident lineage
exclude: generic out-of-memory or setup failures with no sparse-method causal link
launch announcements without a negative receipt
benchmark deltas with no inspectable source
duplicate retellings of the same underlying failure

evidence_classes.demonstrated: Primary artifact with controlled experiments, runnable reproduction, or detailed receipts and a resolved mechanism.
evidence_classes.verified_witness: Inspectible primary report with a concrete configuration and observable failure, but incomplete control or unresolved mechanism.
evidence_classes.suggestive: Firsthand observation or linked artifact with meaningful detail but material confounds or missing replication.
evidence_classes.claim_only: Anecdote or assertion without an inspectable receipt; never promoted into the main ranked evidence.

failure_patterns.definition: A quantized or sparse kernel changes outputs, emits gibberish, or behaves differently across hardware despite the same logical model.
Individually supported features fail when composed, such as sparsity plus low-bit quantization, CUDA graphs, tensor parallelism, or a particular dtype.
Theoretical FLOP or byte savings do not become end-to-end decode throughput because memory bounds, padding, setup, dispatch, or dequantization dominate.
Aggregate or conversational quality hides concentrated degradation in math, code, tools, multilingual work, long outputs, or long context.
A tiny set of high-magnitude or high-salience weights or activation channels carries disproportionate behavior, so uniform quantization or pruning destroys critical signal.
Quantized runtime state such as the KV cache corrupts only after long generation, reuse, or multiple turns.
Pruned zeros do not save memory or time without a compatible compressed representation, and sparse metadata can erase nominal savings.
Task-level benchmark parity is mistaken for trajectory, distribution, or capability preservation.
A method is viable only for a narrow model, GPU, shape, runtime, or version and fails or falls back elsewhere.
Recovery training restores headline benchmarks after pruning while leaving outlier knowledge or emergent capabilities unmeasured.
Conversion choices such as requantization, calibration, tensor selection, or format mismatch introduce avoidable quality loss.

row_contract.unit: one underlying complaint lineage with a primary source and all duplicate or corroborating URLs
required_boundaries: model and exact file when recoverable
runtime, hardware, topology, task, and state
row_contract.ranking: Attention and evidential support remain separate. Popularity cannot promote an unverified claim, while independent reproductions, controlled baselines, maintainer confirmation, and working fixes strengthen a lineage.
